text:
Riley: Quick heads-up — Performance Digest v1 goes live next Mon. Need X + LinkedIn threads, a 6s clip for stitch, image specs, and SDR routing for demo signups. Who can own posting and UTM tagging?

Devon: I can run X scheduling. Will draft 4 short thread variants and a carousel. Need final assets by 9am Mon. ETA copy by EOD today.

Ana: I'll export hero images: 1600x900 (cover), 1080x1080 (square), header_x_1500x500.png, and a 6s loop (clip-6s.mp4). Uploading to Drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/perf_digest_assets_example

Priya: SDR routing plan: form -> /leads/perf-digest-2026, tag=organic_social, owner=growth-sdrs. UTMs: utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=perf_digest_launch. @SDR Bot can you create rule perf_digest_launch -> Growth SDRs?

SDR Bot: Created rule perf_digest_launch -> Growth SDRs, priority=high, tags=[organic_social, perf_digest]. :white_check_mark:

Devon: Draft thread variants (short previews):
Variant 1 (hook): "Performance Digest: 4x throughput, 30% lower unit cost. TL;DR + demo link"
Variant 2 (ops): "Ops playbook inside  batching + cache = predictable latency. See configs."
Variant 3 (customer): "Customer X cut cost per request by 35% in production. Case + how-to."
Variant 4 (tech): "Under the hood: kernel choices, quant config, and perf knobs. Deep dive -> link"

Devon: Posting cadence proposal:
- Mon 11:00 PT: X main thread (Variant 1)
- Mon 11:15 PT: LinkedIn short post (TL;DR)
- Mon 14:00 PT: X carousel (Variant 2 or 3)
- Tue 11:00 PT: Follow-up AMA thread (announce 24h after)

Riley: Nice. Add UTM + cta_variant param for A/B: cta_variant=alpha|beta. Use /schedule-post and include metadata ab_test=true if running both.

Ana: Assets uploaded: hero_1600x900.png, hero_1080.png, header_x_1500x500.png, clip-6s.mp4. All in Drive link above. File sizes in the folder.

Sam: Engagement plan: we'll do seeded replies + pin one top response. @engage-bot can automate seeding first 3 replies each variant?

engage-bot: Can do. Recommend seeds: 2 comments + 1 technical reply per thread. Will run for first 6 hours.

Priya: Seed comment examples (for Devon):
1) "Big props to infra — this changes serving economics :rocket:"
2) "Want configs? We linked the repo and reproducible scripts."
3) "Curious about multi-tenant behavior? We'll cover it in the AMA."

Devon: I'll include those as pinned replies. Also I'll attach UTM strings to every link before scheduling.

Riley: SDR playbook quick bullets for inbound demo signups (pasteable):
- <30m: Send intro email with perf digest link + 2 tailored bullets referencing prospect use-case.
- <24h: If MQL, book demo and mark lead as demo_pipeline.
- After 3 unanswered outreach attempts: tag nurture and enroll in 30-day drip.
Include note: copy utm_campaign and source into CRM lead notes.

Priya: Added playbook to CRM templates and linked to Marketing > Launches > Perf Digest.

Devon: One more ask: can we test two CTA texts? Alpha="See the report" Beta="Book a demo". I'll add cta_variant param when scheduling.

Riley: Perfect. Final checklist: Devon queue posts with /schedule-post, Ana confirm assets uploaded, engage-bot seed comments first 6h, SDR Bot routing rule in place, Priya confirm CRM templates. Pre-launch check Mon 10:30 PT.

Sam: noted. I'll monitor mentions and escalate demo requests to SDRs.

Riley: Thanks all  closing loop.
